newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $7.32 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $7.32 million in T-bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 158 million rupees ($7.32 million) worth of T-bills at its weekly auction from the 400 million rupees tendered, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 88.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 8.31 percent against 141.0 million rupees at 8.19 percent last week.
It sold 182-day bills worth 25.0 million rupees with an average yield of 8.49 percent against 94.0 million rupees at 8.31 percent last week.
The bank also sold 364-day bills worth 45.0 million rupees at an average yield of 8.49 percent, against 109.0 million rupees at 8.46 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 8.39 percent per annum from 8.31 percent last week, the bank said.
